stories.title: 25 years since 9/11, remembrances and a pledge to never forget
stories.summary: Events to honor the nearly 3,000 who perished on 9/11 and more are underway Friday, including in New York City.

stories.title: The other side of 9/11: Afghans reckon with America's long shadow
stories.summary: It's been nearly 25 years since the start of the U.S- led invasion of Afghanistan. NPR returns to Kabul to see how Afghans, now back under Taliban rule, are coping with the legacy of that 20 year war.

stories.title: An Oregon nonprofit harvests fruit from backyards and parks for people in need
stories.summary: In the Portland area, one nonprofit harvests edible fruit from thousands of metro trees, shrubs and bushes and distributes it to people in need.

stories.title: How shofars became the spiritual soundtrack of Rosh Hashanah
stories.summary: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset Friday. For many Jews around the world, a highlight of the holiday will be hearing the shofar: an animal's horn blown like a trumpet.

stories.title: For swing voters in Michigan, Trump's Canada tariffs feel personal
stories.summary: Swing voters in Michigan are sour on the economy — and President Trump's handling of it. That's one takeaway from a pair of focus groups this week.

stories.title: Trump heads to Ireland to watch some golf at his club and conduct some diplomacy
stories.summary: President Trump heads to Ireland hoping for a little diplomacy as he watches a tournament at his golf club in Doonbeg.
